ana: Quick heads-up — planning to onboard nova-3b (float16 quant) to the model catalog today. Canary window 18:00-18:30 PT. Need deploy owner, smoke runbook, rollback tag.
jordan: I can own the deploy. Will be on call during the window.
carla: I'll run the smoke tests and QA prompts. Which endpoint will we pin?
nana: (typo) ignore — wrong channel
ana: (deleted message)
ana: We'll pin `redwood/nova-3b@v1.0.0` to the canary route `nova-canary`. If canary passes, promote to `nova-stable` tomorrow morning.
mike: Add me for rollback steps. I can revert traffic and pin back to `turbine-7b-v2` if needed.
nana: Smoke checklist (short):
- sanity generation (3 prompts)
- perf/latency check (p50/p95)
- embedding sanity
- logs/trace capture
- metric regression check (quick BLEU / QA-F1 on key prompts)
carla: I'll use the smoke harness at `scripts/smoke/nova_canary.sh`. Will post logs here.
jordan: Deploy plan:
1) push catalog pin (staging)
2) smoke in staging
3) schedule prod canary (1% traffic -> 10% after 10m)
4) monitor 30m -> promote or rollback
ana: pin config we will apply (example):
```
{
  "model": "redwood/nova-3b",
  "version": "v1.0.0",
  "route": "nova-canary",
  "traffic_percent": 1
}
```
nora: Heads-up: quota for dedicated pools is low today — if we see OOMs fallback to cpu-small and notify SRE.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for 1979012345 by jordan to route nova-canary at 2026-03-17T18:00:00-07:00
carla: starting smoke in 5m — will paste logs and quick summary here.
mike: I'll be ready to cut traffic back to 0 and re-pin if errors >5% or latency p95 > 1.2s. Also will coordinate with infra if we need extra capacity.
nana: thanks team — post results here. @here please ACK if you're on call :thumbsup: 
jordan: ACK :thumbsup:
carla: ACK

carla: smoke run results: sanity prompts ok (3/3), p50 0.33s p95 0.96s, embeddings stable, 0 errors in 200 requests. Logs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/logs/1979012345/nova-smoke
ana: great — looks good. Plan to move to 10% after 10m of monitoring.

carla: monitoring, will report back after 10m.
carla: 10m check: no regressions, p95 steady at 1.02s, error rate 0.8% — within threshold.

nana: promote to nova-stable scheduled for 2026-03-18 09:00 PT unless we see issues. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround :rocket:
